name: iMessage osascript — Continuity SMS fallback
description: Send-only iMessage path via Apple Messages.app + osascript. Bypasses openclaw's broken imessage channel (issue #75792, observed earlier on Joseph's 94 MB chat.db). Apple Continuity SMS routes via the iPhone's LTE link when iMessage is offline — the deepest-reach fallback in the cascade. v0.1 ships as a tool plugin (sms_bridge) with programmatic API; v0.2 may upgrade to a full channel plugin.

defaultBuddy.label: Default recipient (E.164 or Apple ID)
defaultBuddy.help: Used when the tool is invoked without an explicit `buddy` argument.

timeoutMs.label: Send timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.help: Hard SIGKILL on the osascript subprocess if Messages.app hangs.

recordToLedger.label: Record sends to reach-ledger
recordToLedger.help: When true, every send writes an entry to @openclaw/plugin-reach-ledger under channel name 'sms-bridge'.
